fact: UIXP says it began and ended 2024 with 32 connected networks, including six at the Raxio carrier-neutral data centre, with its switching infrastructure operating reliably.

Traffic: approximately 40 Gbps (peak) at UIXP in 2024, the UIXP's own report for the year, with a mid-year dip after Google's remote peering ended and a rise in November when the Akamai cache was restored.
UIXP deployed a Netflix cache in 2024, reachable by connected networks through its route servers, with cache-fill donated by Lyca Mobile; Netflix also connected to UIXP as a new peer.
UIXP restored an Akamai cache to service on an experimental basis in 2024 (traffic boost in November), using cache-fill bandwidth donated by RENU.

Internet Society Pulse record says the UIXP was exempted from the January 2026 election shutdown order as critical infrastructure and recorded a traffic drop from 13 January, so it was operating (document date is the retrieval date).

Ventureburn reports that the Raxio Data Centre in Uganda hosts the Uganda Internet eXchange Point (UIXP), where networks interconnect directly and exchange traffic at a common point; no member count given. Dated by the article (2020-12-14), which gives no other date for the statement.
